items.body:
Please report any suspected Rich vulnerability through [SECURITY.md](https://github.com/Textualize/rich/blob/master/SECURITY.md). The audit output names Pygments and Requests; Pygments is a Rich dependency, while Requests is not listed among Rich's declared dependencies. These findings describe the named packages and do not by themselves show that Rich is vulnerable. For the Requests finding, identify which package in your environment installed it.

<sub>Automated first-response triage (rich-triage skill). A maintainer will review.</sub>
